name: Syngene International

headline.text: Q2 FY27: revenue ₹833 cr (−8.6% YoY), PAT ₹32 cr (−52.2% YoY).
Trailing twelve months: revenue ₹3,522 cr, EBITDA ₹751 cr (21.3% margin), PAT ₹186 cr.

claims.text: Revenue compounded at 11.4% a year over FY21–FY26 (₹2,184 cr → ₹3,739 cr).
FY26 revenue growth of 2.7% was the slowest in 5 years.
EBITDA margin compressed by 487 bps over FY23–FY26 (29.5% → 24.6%).
PAT compounded at −4.8% a year over FY21–FY26, lagging revenue.
Debt-to-equity was 0.10 at FY27 end (0.13 at FY24).
Over the last 5 years, operating cash flow was 2.08× reported profit (₹4,530 cr vs ₹2,183 cr) — profits are turning into cash.

citations.section: Operating cash flow FY26 not located on a page

claims.text: Free cash flow (as computed by screener.in) was positive in 5 of the last 5 years, ₹1,908 cr in total.
Capex over the last 5 years was ₹2,622 cr, 58% of operating cash flow (derived as operating cash flow − free cash flow).
Cash conversion cycle shortened from 92 to -32 days over FY23–FY26.
Return on capital employed was 10% in FY26 (15% in FY23).

statements.speaker: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw
statements.quote: For the full financial year, we do expect a single-digit decline in revenue in rupee terms and EBITDA margins in the mid-20s.

statements.speaker: Kunal Dhamesha
statements.quote: First question on our guidance revision, which I think earlier we had mentioned it would be more or less flat revenue, and now we have revised down to degrowth of low single digits.

statements.speaker: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw
statements.quote: But by the time we start filling this gap with other customers, we believe it will be the end of this fiscal, and therefore, we are projecting or guiding for a slight decline in revenue.

statements.speaker: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw
statements.quote: And what we are basically now doing is really rebuilding the business, rejigging the business and making sure that we get back to this very robust growth because our aim is to really get back to a double-digit sustainable growth, which we think we will be able to do starting next fiscal.

statements.speaker: Bino Pathiparampil
statements.quote: So, first quarter you have done 12% or 19% whatever depending on the way you look at it, including the hedging losses, etc. Your guidance of mid- 20s EBITDA margin assumes a very strong second half, which should be in the line of 27% to 30% to achieve that annual guidance.

verdict.basis: No reported numbers for H2 FY27 yet

statements.assessmentNote: No reported numbers for H2 FY27 yet

statements.speaker: Neelam Punjabi
statements.quote: My first question is that since we are guiding for a single-digit INR terms revenue decline and we are also having the Bayview facility operationalization in the later part of the year, guiding for a mid-20s EBITDA margin, which would mean that we are doing a very strict cost control.

statements.speaker: Peter Bains
statements.quote: We are very pleased to have Kiran's leadership and guidance at the executive level as the company transitions into its next phase of growth.

statements.speaker: Peter Bains
statements.quote: Syngene's full year revenue from operations grew 3% and overall performance was in line with our revised guidance.

statements.speaker: Surya Patra
statements.quote: Sir, just wanted to understand compared to the guidance what we had given in the third quarter where we have been saying that there will be kind of underperformance both in terms of revenue as well as on the margin front.

statements.speaker: Deepak Jain
statements.quote: That's what's led to an improved margin versus what we guided it to be.

statements.speaker: Deepak Jain
statements.quote: And therefore, margins have shown an improvement, and we'll continue to hold the margins as we've guided.

statements.speaker: Shyam Srinivasan
statements.quote: And now when we look at our guidance for next year, it seems to suggest flat margins.

statements.speaker: Shyam Srinivasan
statements.quote: So, I'm just a little confused with respect to the EBITDA margin guidance.

statements.speaker: Shyam Srinivasan
statements.quote: I think on revenue, we have probably met full year guidance for fiscal '25, '26.

statements.speaker: Shyam Srinivasan
statements.quote: Now we are $419 million in '26, and we are guiding for flat growth.

statements.speaker: Deepak Jain
statements.quote: But the margin structure is what we've commented upon, and we're going to probably hold on to the margin guidance that we've given.

statements.speaker: Deepak Jain
statements.quote: We expect to close the full year with a decline in revenue in the range of 3% to 5% with operating EBITDA margin in the range of 22% to 23%.

verdict.basis: screener.in standardised P&L: operating profit ÷ sales. Company-defined EBITDA can differ by a few tenths.

statements.speaker: Alankar Garude
statements.quote: The first question, when we had our second quarter call in November, you had mentioned mid-single-digit top-line growth guidance and constant currency terms, and now you are talking about a 3% to 5% decline.

statements.speaker: Peter Bains
statements.quote: And, of course, that is the focus now is to accelerate that growth across all fronts and pick up on these encouraging signs of growth that we have and accelerate that and then we will be giving formal guidance for ‘27 in our fourth quarter results.

statements.speaker: Peter Bains
statements.quote: Again, our focus will be on leveraging the diverse capabilities that we have in chemistry, and we spoke about those investments in biology, and in translational clinical sciences and look to accelerate the growth that we have, which, Deepak has advised underlying, is in that high single digit, low double digit, and of course, that is for us to build that, and accelerate that further.

statements.speaker: Deepak Jain
statements.quote: With FY '26 being a transient year, our full year margins are expected to be in the mid-20s as guided earlier.

statements.speaker: Deepak Jain
statements.quote: We advised in April about FY 26 being a transient year on a reported basis and, in constant currency, we guided to a mid-single-digit growth on revenue.

statements.speaker: Deepak Jain
statements.quote: We also guided towards a mid-20s EBITDA margin and a declining path.

statements.speaker: Chirag Dagli
statements.quote: And the second one was on the -- while I understand you won't give an FY '27 outlook, but when I look at history, typically you've never had more than 2 years of single-digit growth, and FY '26 will be the third year of single-digit growth.

statements.speaker: Deepak Jain
statements.quote: When we came at the beginning of the year, we said we have a single digit -- mid-single-digit growth that we are guiding towards.

statements.speaker: Deepak Jain
statements.quote: And we'd said underlying growth still continues to remain robust and is strong, which is what we hold because we are holding our guidance.

statements.speaker: Deepak Jain
statements.quote: In terms of the impact on margin that you just mentioned, I think, as I said, we continue to hold the guidance for this year.

statements.speaker: Deepak Jain
statements.quote: We continue to rationale the fact that the guidance of this year of the mid- 20s on EBITDA and a declining PAT for this year was also transient in the nature and, more importantly, it was also driven by the one-offs that we are seeing in the business.

statements.speaker: Deepak Jain
statements.quote: For '26, we've guided to a $45 million of capex investments with an incremental $10 million of capex investment going into our Bayview facility as well.

evidence.excerpt: Segmental Information Operating segments The Company is engaged in a single operating segment of providing contract research and manufacturing services.

management.excerpt: We are strengthening our commercial organization under the leadership of Abhijit Zutshi, a former Chief Commercial Officer of Biocon's Generics business, who has delivered very significant performance during this role. Abhijit will make sure that we have a sharper market segmentation, greater customer engagement and a more focused business development approach.
management.speaker: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw

management.excerpt: Over the past few years, I believe we have drifted towards the larger share of commoditized research services where differentiation is limited, and pricing pressure is inevitable. At the same time, our biologics manufacturing business became disproportionately dependent on a single large customer.
